input.headline: Groß stars in Brighton's rout at Coventry as Haaland scores again

cards.badge: Scored in 3 gameweeks in a row
cards.text: The winner at Man Utd kept Haaland's captains ticking over, though the penalty-saving Raya would have paid far more with the armband.

cards.title: Matches that mattered
cards.text: Groß (17 points) led a Brighton rout backed by Dunk (12 points) and De Cuyper (11 points). Bogle (15 points) starred for Leeds.

cards.title: The most-owned picks
cards.text: João Pedro rewarded the biggest following in the game with his best score of the season, while B.Fernandes blanked for a 2nd week running.
The Rogers bandwagon paid off with a goal against Hull City, but the managers who sold Calvert-Lewin watched him haul.
